run_f_gold: run f_gold to calculate total Manhattan distance energy for sorting an n by n matrix
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple matrix inputs to verify correct energy calculation
create_f_filled: create a function f_filled that replicates the f_gold minimum cost sort matrix logic
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to optimize the nested loop energy calculation for large matrices
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes total displacement energy to sort numbers 0 to n squared minus 1
